material.acceptance_criteria: ci-status on a sha that carries 24b486af reports every workflow run green, with the first-draw median under the ceiling, or the ceiling is shown to be noise-bound with a dispatch id.
material.description: Publish sha 24b486af (Export each unit's max hit points through the wasm bridge) has the ci workflow green (run 40160654973, 3 of 3 jobs) and the pages workflow red (run 40160654999): job 'first draw of the built page' fails at scripts/perf/first-draw.mjs, median-ms=10380 against ceiling-ms=10000 (loads 11237, 10380, 9645). The same job passed at median 5703 ms on d8c4d97f (run 40160600168) and at median 5422 ms on ebbafb25 (run 40160800716), which contains 24b486af. The change is one read-only wasm export, so the 10.4 s reading is runner timing noise, not a regression. Clearing action: a CI owner re-runs pages on a fresh sha (not a rerun of 24b486af: its deploy would overwrite the newer live page) or reviews the first-draw ceiling against the wait-bound noise recorded in project memory. Evidence: ci-status dispatch 1792901814945-5227-5b4628cb3b66b742 (run_status failure on 24b486af). Blocks LAMPORT-trav-hud-client-LAMPORT-2-blocker-drain-gui-hud-client-1: its witness is ci green on the publish sha.
material.subject: CI: pages first-draw job red on the unit_max_hps publish sha 24b486af (timing ceiling)
material.witness: The first-draw red was a 10380 ms reading against a 10000 ms ceiling on 24b486af. The same job passed on ebbafb25 and 9400c259, which contain that commit. Witness is the ci-status read of 9400c259 from session verify-ci-pages-first-draw-red-on-24b486af.
